app.name: DClaw Recruit
app.tagline: Next-Gen AI Recruiting — Skills-Based, Internal-First, Candidate-Centric
app.description: Move beyond traditional ATS. DClaw Recruit uses AI screening interviews, skills-based hiring, internal mobility matching, and a transparent candidate experience hub — built for how hiring works in 2026.

hero.headline: Hire for Skills, Not Resumes — The 2026 Recruiting Stack
hero.subheadline: DClaw Recruit combines AI-screening interviews, skills-based assessments, internal mobility matching, and a transparent candidate hub. Ditch outdated ATS workflows and hire like the best tech companies.

features.heading: The 2026 Recruiting Stack — Built for How Hiring Actually Works Now
features.subheading: Traditional ATS features are table stakes. DClaw Recruit layers AI-native capabilities that leading companies (Gem, Ashby, Mercor) are adopting today.

items.title: AI Screening Interviews
items.description: AI conducts first-round screening — assessing communication, technical accuracy, and culture fit from voice/video responses. Cuts phone screen time by 80%.
benefits: AI analyzes soft skills and communication quality
Consistent, unbiased screening for every candidate

items.title: Skills-Based Hiring Engine
items.description: Infer verified skills from GitHub repos, portfolios, and project descriptions — not just resume keywords. Match candidates based on what they can actually do.
benefits: Skill inference from code, projects, and portfolios
Role readiness scores with gap analysis

items.title: Internal Mobility AI
items.description: Before posting externally, AI scans your existing workforce for employees ready to move. Hire from within first — slash external recruiting costs.
benefits: AI matches employees to open roles by skill overlap
Save $20K+ per internal hire vs external

items.title: Candidate Experience Hub
items.description: No more candidate ghosting. Real-time pipeline transparency, AI chatbot for instant answers, self-scheduling, and structured feedback after every round.

items.title: AI Recruit Copilot
items.description: Your intelligent recruiting assistant that sources candidates, screens resumes, generates JDs, and predicts hiring outcomes — all with natural language commands.
benefits: Generate optimized JDs in under 2 minutes
Rank 100+ resumes by relevance and skill fit

items.title: Recruitment Analytics & DEI
items.description: Track 15+ metrics, real-time diversity pipeline analytics, predictive time-to-hire, and source effectiveness. Catch bias before it affects hiring.
benefits: Bias interception alerts at every stage

steps.title: Post a Job
steps.description: Use the AI copilot to generate an optimized job description, or write your own. Publish to your career page and syndicate to job boards.

steps.title: Source & Screen
steps.description: AI finds passive candidates and screens incoming resumes, ranking them by match score and flagging top prospects automatically.

steps.title: Interview & Evaluate
steps.description: Schedule interviews with one click. Use structured scorecards with AI-generated rubrics to evaluate candidates consistently.

steps.title: Extend Offers & Hire
steps.description: Generate offer letters, route for approval, collect e-signatures, and trigger onboarding — all from one platform.

items.quote: DClaw Recruit's AI copilot saved us 15 hours per week on resume screening. We're hiring faster and with better outcomes.
items.author: Sarah Chen

items.quote: The interview scheduling alone is worth it. Coordinating 5 interviewers across 3 timezones used to take days. Now it takes minutes.
items.author: Marcus Johnson

items.quote: We reduced our time-to-hire by 40% in the first quarter. The predictive analytics helped us optimize our entire funnel.
items.author: Priya Patel
